import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# H_0 vs. eta_q
eta_q = np.linspace(6.7e-6, 8.3e-6, 100)
H_0 = 71.8 * np.sqrt(1 + 2.29e-18 * (eta_q - 7.1e-6))
plt.plot(eta_q, H_0, label='H_0')
plt.axhline(y=72.1, color='r', linestyle='--', label='DESI Upper Limit')
plt.axhline(y=71.5, color='r', linestyle='--', label='DESI Lower Limit')
plt.xlabel('eta_q (GeV^-1)')
plt.ylabel('H_0 (km/s/Mpc)')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
# n_s vs. eta_w
eta_w = np.linspace(8.2e-5, 8.8e-5, 100)
n_s = 0.964 - 1.06e-45 * (eta_w - 8.5e-5)
